body.name: \(\widehat{\mathcal C}_{\mathrm{ad}}(Y_0,Y_1)\)
body.construction: Enumerate every \(S\subseteq[N]\) with \(|S|\le s\); for each support solve the compact joint Gaussian mean and subspace feasibility problem, and return \(\widehat{\mathcal C}_{\mathrm{ad}}=\{b\in[-B,B]^N:\|b\|_0\le s,\ \exists P'\in\mathcal K_0(Y_0),\ \exists m'\in\operatorname{range}(P'),\ \|m'\|_2\le A,\ \|z-m'-b\|_2\le\varepsilon_1\}\), where \(\varepsilon_1=\sigma_{\mathrm{hi}}\sqrt{q_{N,1-\alpha/2}/T_1}\).
